**Limitations**

- Rounds off corners. Removes lines thinner than half the window.
- Weaker than linear smoothing on Gaussian noise.
- Large windows turn texture into flat patches.

**Artifacts**

- Blotches and streaks with large windows.
- Color fringes at color edges, because channels are filtered separately.
